record_type_quote:
An analysis only using observations that were not used in the original study.
      This is the focal replication analysis of the study. New data come from
      additional waves of the DHS, after 2005.

targets.title: The Impact of the AIDS Pandemic on Health Services in Africa: Evidence from Demographic and Health Surveys
targets.evidence_quote:
The claim selected from Case & Paxson (2011) is that the quality of maternal and child
health care has deteriorated in regions with high recent HIV prevalence relative to
regions with low recent HIV prevalence.
targets.outcome_quote:
The estimated coefficient for the main variable “prevalence” is positive, and
insignificant. Thus the replication claim was unsuccessful according to the SCORE
criteria.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The explicitly designated focal replication uses only new observations and fails. The pooled old-plus-new analysis succeeds, but is a secondary analysis; the report explicitly says weighting does not change the overall conclusion for the focal new-data replication.

reasoning: Independent new DHS survey waves re-test the specified published claim. The OSF final report identifies the assigned Case/Paxson work and Hong, Duan, Coupe and Reed team; additional project metadata authors do not all appear on the report. Treat the published study as one target. Tables are embedded images, while narrative results and full reference citation are extracted.
